title: Slow English Podcast: My Trip to New York City 🇺🇸 Level B1

header.titleEn: Slow English Podcast: My Trip to New York City 🇺🇸 Level B1

sentences.en: Welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I'm going to talk about my trip to New York. the whole entire story from the moment.
sentences.tc: 今天我要談談我的紐約之旅。整個故事從那一刻開始。

sentences.en: I arrived at the airport to my home in Nebraska to New York and back in Mexico City.
sentences.tc: 我抵達機場，前往內布拉斯加州的家，飛往紐約，然後返回墨西哥城。

sentences.en: In the morning, my family and I woke up at around 4 a.m. super early because my dad had to drive us to the airport.
sentences.tc: 早上，我和我的家人在凌晨 4 點左右就起床了，因為我爸爸要開車送我們去機場。

sentences.en: Then go to his work. So, my mom, my sister, my brother, and I woke up, got our bags, and head to the airport in Mexico City. Once.
sentences.tc: 然後去他的工作。於是，我的媽媽、姊姊、弟弟和我起床，拿起行李，前往墨西哥城的機場。一次。

sentences.en: We arrived at the airport,.
sentences.tc: 我們到達機場，。

sentences.en: We had to find our airline. Our airline was United or Ido Mexico.
sentences.tc: 我們必須找到我們的航空公司。我們的航空公司是聯合航空或墨西哥伊多航空。

sentences.en: We found our airline.
sentences.tc: 我們找到了我們的航空公司。

sentences.en: We checked a bag.

sentences.en: We went through security check. The security check this time was so chill. The security guards were super friendly and not intense or angry at all. So, it was a good start.
sentences.tc: 我們通過了安​​全檢查。這次的安檢真是太冷了。保安人員非常友好，一點也不緊張或生氣。所以，這是一個好的開始。

sentences.en: To a good trip.
sentences.tc: 祝旅途愉快。

sentences.en: We were past security,.
sentences.tc: 我們過了安檢。

sentences.en: We had to walk through the dutyfree section. The section where everything is dutyfree.
sentences.tc: 我們必須穿過免稅區。一切都是免稅的部分。

sentences.en: We were so hungry.
sentences.tc: 我們太餓了。

sentences.en: We hadn't eaten anything since the night before. So,.
sentences.tc: 從前一天晚上開始我們就沒吃過任何東西。所以，。

sentences.en: We all made a unanimous decision to get breakfast at Carl's Jr. and it was so yummy.
sentences.tc: 我們一致決定在 Carl's Jr. 吃早餐，非常美味。

sentences.en: I had the deluxe meal that has pancakes, bacon, tater tots, and a piece of toast. My brother and my sister got the breakfast burrito and my mom got the breakfast burger.
sentences.tc: 我吃了一頓豪華大餐，有煎餅、培根、馬鈴薯泥和一片吐司。我哥哥和姊姊吃了早餐捲餅，我媽媽吃了早餐漢堡。

sentences.en: We had plenty of time to find our gate. So,.
sentences.tc: 我們有足夠的時間找到登機口。所以，。

sentences.en: We were in no rush.

sentences.en: First flight in Dallas. That was our.

sentences.en: Then our second flight to Omaha, Nebraska. And that's where my aunt picked us up in her car and drove us to her home.
sentences.tc: 然後我們的第二班航班飛往內布拉斯加州奧馬哈。那就是我阿姨開車接我們並開車送我們去她家的地方。

sentences.en: I saw the big roads right away. The roads in the United States always surprise me.
sentences.tc: 我立刻就看到大路了。美國的道路總是讓我感到驚訝。
